name: distractor-heavy

manifest.title: Flow Editor source-contract regexes pin source text
manifest.description: Matters when editing flow-editor authoring components: the source-contract regexes pin exact source text, so refactors that touch pinned lines must update the contracts in the same change.

manifest.title: Flow Editor reconcile has a circuit breaker
manifest.description: Matters when reconcile loops or stalls during flow-editor testing: a circuit breaker trips after repeated failed reconciles and must be reset.

manifest.title: Favicon route shadows flow-editor asset paths
manifest.description: Matters when adding new static asset routes to the flow-editor server: the favicon route can shadow them.

manifest.title: Feature branches use feat/ fix/ docs/ refactor/ prefixes
manifest.description: Matters when creating a new branch: follow the repo prefix convention.

manifest.title: Gateway profile capabilities fixed in 0.7.19
manifest.description: Matters when triaging capability-advertisement bugs reported on gateway versions before 0.7.19.

manifest.title: Python SDK tests run with PYTHONPATH=sdk/python
manifest.description: Matters when invoking the Python SDK test suite directly rather than through make.

manifest.title: Cross-mob peer messages drop prompt body in meerkat 0.7.3
manifest.description: Matters when cross-mob sends arrive empty: confirmed meerkat-side defect in actor.rs, not a meta bug.

manifest.title: Meerkat upstream asks doc
manifest.description: Matters when deciding whether a defect should be fixed meta-side or filed upstream: docs/design/upstream-asks.md tracks the filed asks.

manifest.title: Encapsulated flows shared primitive still in flight
manifest.description: Matters when designing callable-flow features: the shared primitive with adaptive-flow-mobpacks is in an in-flight meerkat worktree; coordinate before building on it.

manifest.title: Structured-output flow validates schema against target-keyed aggregate
manifest.description: Matters when flow structured-output validation fails unexpectedly: meerkat validates against the target-keyed aggregate, which blocks the flow-editor schema story.

manifest.title: Never modify prompt or model when driving codemob
manifest.description: Matters when orchestrating codemob consultations: report timeouts instead of substituting models or rewriting prompts.

manifest.title: Bazel builds are remote-only for meta
manifest.description: Matters when someone tries a local bazel build: only hosted BuildBuddy RBE is supported.

manifest.title: Version parity verified by scripts/verify-version-parity.sh
manifest.description: Matters when release CI fails on version parity: the script compares crate and SDK version strings.

manifest.title: Flow editor visual contract tests run under npm test:visual-contract
manifest.description: Matters when choosing which flow-editor test lane to run for a rendering-only change.

turn_text: I need to refactor the flow-editor authoring components to extract a shared node-palette module. What should I watch out for before I start moving code around?
notes: Distractor-heavy manifest: 14 records, many mentioning 'flow editor' or general repo practice. Only the source-contract-pinning gotcha is certain to be helpful for a component refactor; same-domain records (circuit breaker, favicon, visual tests) are left don't-care, while clearly off-task records must not ride along.
